app.title: Payrudder operator console
app.demo: Demo mode: sample data, a mock payment provider, mail goes to the local mail catcher. Nothing here is real.

common.copyFailed: Your browser did not allow copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.

discrepancy.paid_without_charge: Paid, no charge in the ledger

jobs.title: Replay and re-rating jobs
jobs.hint: Look a job up by id (start them with payrudderctl or the admin API).

share.title: Share with the customer
share.hint: A link that shows this invoice and its PDF without signing in. Anyone who has it can open the invoice; it stops working when it expires or is revoked.
share.revoked: Every link to this invoice has been revoked.
share.badDays: Days: a whole number from 1 to 365.

payment.offlineHint: Record money received outside Payrudder (a transfer, cash, other). A partial amount is allowed: the invoice is paid when the payments add up to the total.
payment.transferHint: Confirm what arrived on the bank statement. A partial amount is recorded and the invoice is paid when the transfers add up to the total.
payment.amountHint: Defaults to what is outstanding ({outstanding}). More than that is refused.
payment.referenceHint: Optional. The same reference again is treated as the same payment.
payment.bankReferenceHint: The bank's transaction or statement reference. Required: it makes a repeat harmless.
payment.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, more than zero, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.
payment.badDate: The received date must be a valid date and time, not in the future.

toast.duplicate: This payment had already been recorded.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.rejectHint: Use this when the customer's transfer was refused or will not come. The invoice is not paid and the tenant's dunning schedule applies at once: a new payment window, or uncollectible when no retry is left. Receipts already recorded stay.
transfer.expireHint: Use this when the payment window is over without the money. The invoice is not paid and the tenant's dunning schedule applies at once: a new payment window, or uncollectible when no retry is left. Receipts already recorded stay.
transfer.expiredNote: The payment window ended without the full amount. Dunning applies.
transfer.rejectedNote: The transfer was rejected. Dunning applies.

deadLetters.title: Dead letters
deadLetters.intro: RabbitMQ dead-letter queues ({pattern}). A message lands here after its delivery limit; redrive sends it back with the retry counter reset.
deadLetters.confirm: Move {count} dead letter(s) of {queue} back to {queue}? Their retry counters are reset.

playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: Walk through the whole product in a sandbox: create an account, define what is metered and priced, send usage, close the period and watch the invoice go through its payment saga with a mock payment provider. Nothing here touches a live tenant.

setup.title: 2. What is metered and priced
setup.button: Create meter, plan, customer and subscription

close.title: 4. Close the period
close.hint: Billing runs as at month end; the sandbox just moves the cutoff to now.

invoice.title: 5. Invoice
invoice.waiting: Waiting for the billing run (about 40 seconds)…

log.title: Done so far
log.version: Plan version: 10.00 base fee + 0.01 per call

packages.intro: Publishing a package that exists adds a new version. A version is fixed once published; subscriptions keep the version they started on.
packages.name: Name
packages.addFee: Add a fee in another currency
packages.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.
packages.interval: Billing interval of the extra fee
packages.tenantMonthly: The monthly fee in {currency} is the fixed fee above.

subscriptions.providerRuns: {provider} runs this subscription: renewals and retries are its. Change it there; it can be moved to another provider below.
subscriptions.changePlanHint: The change takes effect now. This month's fixed fee is split between the two packages by the time on each.
subscriptions.moveHint: The old subscription ends only when the new one takes over, so the customer is never billed by both.
subscriptions.checkoutReady: The customer subscribes here; the move completes when the provider confirms:
subscriptions.moved: Moved: the new subscription takes over where the old one ends.
subscriptions.noLimits: This package sets no usage limits.

change.title: Change plan or interval
change.auto: When: by direction of the change
change.atEnd: At the end of the paid period
change.creditAdded: {amount} is added to the credit balance

providerRun.title: Run by {provider}
providerRun.hint: These actions are made at the provider; Payrudder's copy follows when the provider's notification arrives. A change is billed by the provider and applies at once.
providerRun.none: No proration: billed from the next renewal
providerRun.atPeriodEnd: Pause at the end of the paid period
providerRun.requested: Requested. This page updates when the provider confirms.

subscriptions.endNowCredit: End now and credit the unused part
subscriptions.confirmEndCredit: End this subscription now and credit the customer with the unused part of the fee they paid in advance?

payments.reconcileHint: Compares the invoices billing calls paid in a period with the successful charges the providers reported.
payments.summary: {paid} paid invoice(s) and {charges} successful charge(s) in the ledger.
payments.agree: The invoices and the ledger agree.
payments.truncated: Only the first discrepancies are listed; the counts above are complete.

providers.accountsHint: The tenant's own accounts at payment providers. Credentials are sealed when saved and never shown again.
providers.makeDefault: Live charges go here by default
providers.webhookHint: The provider sends its notifications to {path} on the gateway's public address.
providers.badJson: The settings are not valid JSON.
providers.routingHint: The first rule that matches a customer's country and the subscription's currency chooses the provider of a new subscription. No match: the default account. Existing subscriptions stay where they are.
providers.noRules: No rules: every new subscription goes to the default account.
providers.cannotCharge: That provider cannot charge in this currency.
providers.goesToDefault: No rule matches: the default account.
providers.noProviderSubscriptions: No subscription is run by a provider yet.

catalogue.title: Catalogue at the provider
catalogue.hint: Makes the provider hold a package, so it can be sold and changed there: its product once, and a price for every interval and currency the version has a fee in. Syncing twice changes nothing.
catalogue.empty: Nothing has been created at this provider yet.

bank.title: Bank transfer account
bank.sandboxNote: Sandbox charges never reach this provider (the mock payment provider handles them). Save the account in live to use it.
bank.ibanHint: Spaces and dashes are removed and the letters upper-cased; the check digits are verified.
bank.referenceHint: What the customer writes on the transfer. {number} and {id} are available; the default is the invoice number.
bank.currenciesHint: The currencies this account receives. None ticked: every currency.
bank.windowHint: How long to wait for the money, 0 to 90. 0 or empty uses the deployment default.

errors.format: An IBAN is two letters, two digits, then letters and digits.
errors.checksum: The check digits do not match: look for a typo.
errors.badBic: A BIC has 8 or 11 letters and digits.
errors.badTemplate: Only {number} and {id} may appear in braces.
errors.badWindow: A whole number of days from 0 to 90.

reports.revenueHint: Each currency has its own rows: amounts in different currencies are never added together.
reports.subscriptionsHint: Counted at the last instant of the month. Monthly recurring revenue is the fixed fees of active and past due subscriptions. A plan change or a provider move is neither new nor churn.
reports.dunningHint: Invoices whose payment was declined and is being retried, whose outcome is unknown, or that were given up.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.hint: A coupon takes a percentage or an amount off the fixed fee Payrudder invoices in advance: once, for a number of periods, or for as long as the subscription lasts. A subscription run by a provider uses a discount at the provider instead.
coupons.name: Name
coupons.badPercent: Not a percentage: 0.01 to 100 with at most two decimals.
coupons.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.

tax.title: Tax
tax.hint: Payrudder adds these rates on top of the price to the invoices it raises, by the customer's country (the rate without a country covers all others). You set the rates and are responsible for them; an invoice a provider issues is taxed by the provider.
tax.name: Name {n}
tax.badRate: Not a percentage: 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.

dunning.title: Payment retries
dunning.hint: When a charge is declined, Payrudder tries again after each delay below, then gives the invoice up as uncollectible. Delays are in hours (minutes in a sandbox account).
dunning.defaults: You have not set any: the standard delays are shown.
dunning.none: No retries: a declined charge is given up at once.
dunning.bad: Each delay is a whole number from 1 to 720.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.hint: A coupon says what is taken off. A customer types a promotion code: many codes can point to one coupon, each with its own limit, expiry and rules.
promotions.bonusNote: Bonus credits are added to the same lot as the pack's credits and expire with them. Credit purchases only.
promotions.badBonus: Not a percentage of extra credits: 0.01 to 1000 with at most two decimals.
promotions.withoutDefaultCode: No promotion under the coupon's own name

codes.title: Promotion codes of {coupon}
codes.hint: Name the codes, or generate random ones. Every code gets the limit, expiry and rules below.
codes.restore: Give the use back when the purchase is voided or refunded

errors.names: Name at least one code, and at most 1000: 2 to 40 letters, digits, - or _.
errors.count: How many must be 1 to 1000, and the prefix at most 20 letters, digits, - or _.
errors.max: Uses per code must be a whole number from 1.
errors.expires: The expiry must be a day in the future.
errors.minAmount: Not an amount in that currency: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.
errors.currencies: Currencies are three-letter codes such as USD, separated by commas.

redemptions.title: Redemptions
redemptions.hint: Every use of a coupon. A void or a full refund reverses the use; the count goes back only for codes that say so.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.badAmount: Not an amount in {currency}: digits only, with at most as many decimals as the currency has.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: Payrudder sends a signed JSON POST to these HTTPS endpoints when something happens in the account: an invoice is paid, a credit note is issued, a subscription changes. Verify the Payrudder-Signature header with the endpoint's secret; failed deliveries are retried for about a day and a half.
webhooks.eventsHint: Tick none to receive every event.
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now: it is shown only once.
webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete this endpoint and its delivery history?

paymentLinks.title: Payment links
paymentLinks.hint: A link the customer opens without signing in to pay. For an open invoice, or ad hoc for a fixed amount (the invoice is made when the customer first uses it). Anyone who has the link can pay; it stops working when it expires or is revoked.
paymentLinks.adhocHint: The invoice is made, and numbered, when the customer presses Continue on the page.
paymentLinks.invoiceHint: The invoice must be finalized and unpaid.
paymentLinks.shownOnce: Copy the link now: it is shown once and cannot be read back.
paymentLinks.replayed: This request was already handled: the link exists, but its address is shown only once.
paymentLinks.confirmRevoke: Revoke this link? Unpaid invoices made from it are voided.

errors.amount: Enter a positive amount with the currency's decimals.
errors.description: Say what the payment is for.
errors.days: Days: a whole number from 1 to 365.

portal.title: Payment page of {id}
portal.hint: A link to a page where this customer sees their invoices and payments, downloads PDFs and receipts, and pays what is open. Read-only.
portal.revoked: Every payment page link of this customer has been revoked.
portal.confirmRevoke: Revoke every payment page link of this customer?

paymentLinks.promotionHint: The payer gets this code's discount without typing it and may type another. It is checked against this amount now.

mail.title: E-mail
mail.hint: Choose which kinds of e-mail Payrudder sends to this tenant's customers. A kind that is switched off is dropped, not queued: switching it on again does not send what was skipped.

descriptions.invoice_issued: Tells the customer that a new invoice was finalized.
descriptions.payment_receipts: The receipt after a successful payment.
descriptions.payment_failed: A failed payment, a retry and the notice that Payrudder gave up collecting.
descriptions.usage_alerts: A customer passed a usage limit of its plan.

mail.providerNote: A payment provider that sends its own receipts (Paddle) keeps sending them; this switch only controls Payrudder's mail.

packs.hint: A pack is a number of credits sold for a price. A customer buys it with a payment link; the credits are added when the payment is confirmed.
packs.name: Pack name
packs.title: Credit packs

grant.expiryHint: Leave empty for credits that never expire

purchase.title: Purchase link
purchase.hint: A link the customer opens to buy this pack. When the payment is confirmed the credits are added once. The price is always the pack's.
purchase.shownOnce: Copy the link now: it is shown once and cannot be read back.

settings.title: Low-balance alert
settings.hint: When a customer's balance drops below this number, Payrudder sends the credits.low webhook event once. 0 turns it off.

accounting.title: Income and expenses
accounting.intro: What the tenant earned from paid invoices and what it spent, in each currency on its own.
accounting.currencyNote: Each currency is shown on its own. Amounts in different currencies are never added together or converted.
accounting.empty: No income or expenses in this period.

period.label: Period
period.invalid: Choose a first and a last day, in order, at most five years apart.

app.label: App
app.note: The app limits the expenses. Income is the income of this tenant, which is one app environment.

stat.feesHint: The payment provider's commission is not recorded by Payrudder. Add it as an expense in the category Payment fees.
stat.discountsHint: What coupons took off the paid invoices. Income is already after them.

form.hint: Money the tenant spent. A monthly or yearly expense repeats on its own from its first day.
form.recurringHint: Editing a repeating expense changes every occurrence, past and future.
form.bad: Enter a vendor and an amount above zero with at most the decimals of {currency}.
form.badDates: Enter the date; the last day cannot be before the first.

void.title: Void the expense of {vendor}
void.hint: A voided expense is not deleted. It leaves every total and keeps your reason.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.hint: The invoices paid in the period that used a coupon: what they came to before it, what it took off, and the net.

affiliates.intro: Run a partner program: partners get a link and a code, the customers they bring are remembered, and they earn a commission on what those customers pay. You pay them out yourself.
affiliates.payoutDetailsHint: Free text for you: the IBAN, the account holder or whatever you need when you pay this partner by hand.

overview.noProgram: There is no partner program yet. Set one up to start earning referrals.
overview.inactive: The links are off and no commission is earned until the program is active.
overview.periodNote: Counted over the period you picked. Commissions are shown per currency and never added together.
overview.balancesHint: All partners together, per currency. Currencies are never added together or converted.
overview.noBalances: No commission has been earned yet.
overview.pendingHint: Waiting out the refund window before it can be paid

program.title: Program settings
program.hint: The rules every partner earns under.
program.notSet: There is no program yet. The values below are a sensible start; save to create it.
program.appliesFromNow: A change applies to commissions earned from then on, never to those already earned.
program.statusHint: Draft and paused turn the links off and earn nothing.
program.percentHint: Of the net, pre-tax amount of a paid invoice. Up to two decimals, for example 12.5.
program.fixedHint: Earned only on invoices in the currency below.
program.currencyHint: For a fixed amount and for the minimum payout.
program.windowHint: How long after following a link a customer still counts as the partner's.
program.holdHint: How long a commission waits, the refund window, before it can be paid out.
program.minPayoutHint: A partner below this amount is skipped when you create payouts. Leave empty for none.
program.couponHint: A referred customer gets it on their next checkout. Coupons are made under Pricing.
program.clickCapHint: Clicks above this per day are not counted.
program.landingHint: Where the partner link sends a visitor. Empty shows a plain page.
program.autoApproveHint: A partner who applies is active at once. Otherwise the application waits for you under Affiliates.

errors.value: Enter a commission above zero: a percentage up to 100 with at most two decimals, or an amount in {currency}.
errors.term: Enter the number of invoices or months, a whole number from 1 to 1200.
errors.window: The attribution window is a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
errors.hold: The hold is a whole number of days from 0 to 180.
errors.minPayout: Enter the minimum payout as an amount in {currency}, or leave it empty.
errors.clickCap: The click cap is a whole number from 1 to 100000.
errors.landing: The landing page must be a web address starting with http:// or https://.

partners.search: Search by code, e-mail or name

add.title: Add an affiliate
add.hint: The partner is active at once unless you leave them pending.
add.name: Name
add.codeHint: 3 to 32 letters, numbers, - or _. It must be unique on the whole platform because the public link carries no app. Leave empty for a random one.

link.title: Link and code of {code}
link.hint: Send the partner their link. A customer who types the partner's promotion code at a checkout is attributed to them too.
link.promotionHint: An existing promotion code from Pricing. Redeeming it counts as following the link.

referrals.title: Customers of {code}
referrals.empty: This partner has not brought a customer yet.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.intro: One commission per paid invoice of a customer a partner brought, on the net, pre-tax amount. It waits out the hold, is then approved, and is paid by a payout.

reverse.title: Reverse a commission
reverse.hint: Take back a commission for a chargeback, or by hand.
reverse.auto: Refunds, voids and credit notes reverse commissions on their own. Use this only for what Payrudder cannot see.
reverse.amountHint: Leave empty to take back everything that is left.
reverse.referenceHint: Names this reversal. The same invoice, reason and reference takes back only once.
reverse.paidNote: A commission that was already paid is netted from the partner's next payout.
reverse.badAmount: Enter an amount above zero in {currency}, not more than what is left.
reverse.referenceRequired: A manual reversal needs a reference.
reverse.nothing: Nothing more to take back: this reversal was already done.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: A payout is the approved commissions of one partner in one currency. Payrudder moves no money: pay by hand or bank transfer, then mark the payout paid.
payouts.nothing: Nothing to pay out right now.
payouts.fakeNote: This is a sandbox payout. Nothing was or will be paid.

pay.title: Mark payout as paid
pay.noMoney: Payrudder moves no money. Pay the partner yourself, by hand or bank transfer, then confirm here to post it to your books.
pay.fakeWarning: This is a sandbox payout: nothing is really paid, and its postings are marked fake.
pay.referenceHint: For example the bank transfer reference.

journal.title: Journal
journal.intro: What paid payouts posted to your books: the commission expense against the payable, and the payable against cash.
journal.empty: Nothing posted yet. Paying a payout posts to the journal.

partner.title: Partner portal
partner.intro: The sellers whose program you are a partner of: your links, what you earned and what was paid to you.
partner.verifyHint: Confirm your e-mail address to see the partner records that sellers made for it.

empty.title: You are not a partner of any seller yet
empty.body: Ask a seller to add you as a partner using this e-mail address, or open the application link a seller gave you. Records made for your verified e-mail address show up here by themselves.

banner.pending: Your application is waiting for the seller's approval. Your link starts to earn once you are approved; what you see below is already yours.
banner.suspended: The seller has suspended you. New customers are not attributed to you and nothing new is earned. What was already approved stays yours; ask the seller.
banner.sandbox: This is a sandbox: the seller is testing. Everything here is fake money and nothing will really be paid.

terms.title: The seller's terms
terms.percent: You earn {pct} % of the net amount, before tax, of every invoice a customer you brought pays.
terms.fixed: You earn {amount} on every invoice a customer you brought pays.
terms.firstInvoices: Earned on the first {n} invoices of each customer.
terms.months: Earned for the first {n} months of each customer.
terms.lifetime: Earned for as long as the customer keeps paying.
terms.window: A customer counts as yours for {days} days after following your link.
terms.hold: A commission waits {days} days, the refund window, before it can be paid out.
terms.noMinimum: The seller sets no minimum payout.

earned.title: Earned in this period
earned.note: Per currency, never added together. Figures cover the period you picked; balances below are as of now.

balances.title: Your balance
balances.none: You have not earned anything yet.
balances.pendingHint: Waiting out the refund window before it can be paid

referrals.hint: The e-mail addresses of your customers are masked. The seller keeps everything else about them.
referrals.empty: You have not brought a customer yet.

commissions.hint: A refund takes a commission back in proportion. One that was already paid is netted from your next payout by a negative row.

payouts.empty: Nothing has been paid to you yet.

settings.name: Your name
settings.detailsHint: What the seller needs to pay you, for example your IBAN and account holder.

apply.title: Become a partner
apply.missing: This page needs the link of a seller's program. Open the application link the seller gave you.
apply.pendingBody: The seller has to approve it. You can see your link and your figures already.
apply.activeBody: The seller approves applications automatically. Your link is ready.

einvoice.title: E-invoice
einvoice.confirmCancel: Cancel this legal e-document? This cannot be undone.

settings.title: E-invoicing
settings.hint: Turn invoices and credit notes into legal e-documents (e-fatura, e-arşiv, Peppol) sent through your integrator. The company data below is printed on every document.

account.title: Integrator account
account.hint: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again. The sandbox environment can only use the mock provider.
account.sandboxHint: The sandbox always uses the mock provider: documents are accepted with a fake legal number.
account.neverShown: The secret is sent once and cannot be read back.

account.missing: The tenant has no e-invoice account for this environment.
account.invalid: The e-invoice account settings are not valid.
account.sandbox_mock_only: The sandbox environment can only use the mock provider.

seller.incomplete: The company legal data (name, tax id) is incomplete.

buyer.incomplete: The customer's tax data is incomplete.

document.not_failed: Only a failed e-document can be retried.
document.not_issued: Only an issued e-document can be cancelled.

cancel.unsupported: This provider cannot cancel the document.

file.not_ready: The file is not available yet.

provider.unavailable: The integrator could not be reached; it will be tried again.

setting.invalid: The e-invoice setting is not valid.

customer.tax_invalid: The customer's tax data is not valid.

apps.hint: An app is one of the account's applications, with its own sandbox and live environment, keys, customers and plans. Currency, time zone and grace period are chosen here and cannot be changed later.
apps.name: App name
apps.badSlug: The slug may only have lower-case letters, digits and single dashes, at most 60 characters.
apps.title: Apps of this account
apps.immutable: Renaming and deleting an app is not available in the API yet; an app's currency, time zone and grace period cannot be changed.
apps.empty: This account has no apps yet.

keys.title: API keys of {app}
keys.hint: Create a key for one environment. The key is shown once; the API cannot list keys later, so keys made on this page are listed here until you leave it. A key from elsewhere can be revoked by its id.
keys.secretOnce: Copy the key now: it is shown only once.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke this API key? Requests using it stop working immediately.

address.title: Seller address
address.hint: The legal and billing address of this tenant, printed as the seller on every invoice (PDF and hosted page). It applies to invoices made after you save.

problems.oneLine: Must be one line of text.

address.postalHint: This does not look like a postal code of that country, for example {example}. It is accepted anyway.

preview.title: Invoice preview
preview.hint: How the seller appears on an invoice.
preview.empty: No address: the invoice shows only the name.

credit_note.bad_amount: The credit amount is not valid: it must be more than zero and no more than what is left to credit on the invoice.
credit_note.fully_credited: This invoice has already been credited in full.
credit_note.not_paid: Only a paid invoice can be credited.
credit_note.nothing_to_refund: There is nothing to refund to the card for this credit note.
credit_note.refund_not_failed: Only a credit note whose refund failed can be retried.
credit_note.bad_id: The credit note id is not a valid id.
credit_note.bad_page_size: The page size must be between 1 and 200.
credit_note.bad_page_token: The page token is not valid. Start the list again.
credit_note.not_found: This credit note was not found.
credit_note.reason_too_long: The reason can be at most 500 characters.

dunning.bad_delay: Each retry delay must be between 1 and 720 hours.
dunning.too_many_retries: At most 6 retry delays can be set.

invoice.pdf_not_ready: The invoice PDF has not been rendered yet. Try again in a moment.
invoice.bad_id: The invoice id is not a valid id.
invoice.bad_customer_id: The customer id is not a valid id.
invoice.bad_page_size: The page size must be between 1 and 500.
invoice.bad_page_token: The page token is not valid. Start the list again.
invoice.pdf_sign_failed: The PDF download link could not be created. Try again shortly.
invoice.pdf_failed: The invoice PDF could not be rendered. Check the invoice data.

invoice_link.bad_expiry: The link must expire in 1 to 365 days.
invoice_link.draft_invoice: A draft invoice cannot be shared by link.
invoice_link.not_found: The invoice link was not found.
invoice_link.bad_page_token: The page token is not valid. Start the list again.

payment.amount_mismatch: The payment is not for the amount of the invoice.
payment.invoice_not_payable: Only an open or uncollectible invoice can be paid by hand.
payment.bad_method: The method must be bank transfer, cash or other.

payment.bad_date: The received date is not valid or lies in the future.

payment.reference_reused: This reference was already recorded with a different amount.

payment_link.bad_description: A description is required, at most 200 characters.

payment_link.bad_status: The status must be active, paid, expired or revoked.
payment_link.consumed: This link has already been used.
payment_link.idempotency_conflict: This idempotency key was used for a different payment link.
payment_link.invoice_not_payable: A paid or void invoice needs no payment link.
payment_link.invoice_required: A payment link of kind invoice needs an invoice.
payment_link.not_found: There is no such payment link.
payment_link.customer_required: A credit pack link needs the customer who receives the credits.
payment_link.pack_required: A credit pack link needs a pack.

credits.bad_amount: The amount must be a whole number of credits above zero.
credits.bad_expiry: The expiry date must lie in the future.
credits.bad_key: The idempotency key is too long (at most 128 characters).
credits.bad_pack: A pack needs a name and credits and a price above zero.
credits.bad_page_size: The page size must be between 1 and 200.
credits.bad_page_token: The page token is not valid.
credits.bad_reason: The note is too long (at most 200 characters).
credits.bad_source: The type must be promotion or manual.
credits.insufficient: The customer has too few credits.
credits.key_required: An idempotency key is required to spend credits.
credits.key_reused: This idempotency key was already used for a different request.

keys.liveInactive: Live keys can be made once the live environment is active.
keys.rotateBody: A new key with the same access is made and shown once. The old one keeps working for the time below, so you can switch without a gap.
keys.overlap: Keep the old key working for

links.title: Go deeper
links.intro: The working pages of the {env} environment.
links.readOnly: Your role is viewer: you can read everything here, but changes are not allowed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your organisation, your profile and how this app looks.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.doneBody: If an account exists for {email}, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Saving it signs you out on every device.
reset.doneBody: You were signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.noToken: This page needs the link from your e-mail. Open the link again, or ask for a new one.

verify.banner: Confirm your e-mail address ({email}). You can use the app meanwhile, but live API keys need a confirmed address.

verifyPage.title: Confirming your e-mail address
verifyPage.intro: One moment while we check the link.
verifyPage.doneBody: Thank you. You can now create live API keys.
verifyPage.failBody: It was already used, has expired or was replaced by a newer one. Sign in and ask for a new link.

members.title: Members
members.manageNote: Owners and administrators invite people and manage roles. An administrator cannot change owners.
members.readNote: You can see who is in this account. Only owners and administrators can change it.
members.leaveBody: You lose access to its apps and data at once. An owner can invite you again.
members.removeBody: {name} loses access to this account's apps and data at once.

account.noneTitle: You are not in any account
account.noneBody: You left your last account or were removed from it. Ask an owner to invite you again, or sign up with another address.

invite.title: You are invited
invite.noToken: This page needs the link from your invitation e-mail. Open the link again.
invite.invalid: This invitation is not valid any more: it was used, cancelled, replaced or has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.
invite.joinAs: You are signed in as {email}. Join with this account.
invite.otherUser: This invitation is for {invited}, but you are signed in as {current}. Sign out, then open the link again.
invite.hasAccount: {email} already has an account. Sign in to join.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: What this environment billed. Open one to see its lines and download the PDF.
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. They appear when a billing period closes.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Charges and refunds, newest first. Each payment shows the outcome it settled on.

membersPage.intro: Who belongs to this organisation, their roles, and the invitations that are still open.

apiKeysPage.intro: Keys your server uses to call Payrudder for this app. A key belongs to one environment; its secret is shown once.

appSettings.intro: What this app was created with. The currency and the time zone decide how every invoice is worked out, so they are fixed once the app exists.
appSettings.moreCurrencies: An app can sell in many currencies: add a price in another currency to a package, under

goLive.title: Go live
goLive.pageIntro: The live environment starts switched off: no live keys, no live webhooks, no real charges. Finish the list, then switch it on.
goLive.intro: Your live environment is not active yet. Finish these steps to switch it on.
goLive.suspended: Your live environment is suspended. Contact support to have it reinstated.
goLive.noLive: This deployment has no live environment.

items.legal_profile: Complete the legal profile (name, country, tax id)
items.payment_provider: Connect a payment provider in live mode
items.plan_published: Publish at least one plan in live

help.email_verified: Open the link in the message we sent you, or ask for a new one from the banner.
help.legal_profile: The seller's name, country and tax id are printed on every live invoice.
help.payment_provider: A provider connected for real payments, with its health check passed.
help.plan_published: Copy your sandbox plans to live below, or create one in live.
help.terms_accepted: Accepted together with the activation below, by the owner.

goLive.askTeam: The Payrudder team sets this up with you for now. Contact support.
goLive.nothingYet: Live shows no figures until it is active.
goLive.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of service for this app's live environment.
goLive.ownerOnly: Only the owner of the account can switch live on.
goLive.inactiveNote: Live has no data until it is active. Your sandbox keeps working in the meantime.

promote.title: Copy sandbox configuration to live
promote.intro: Meters, plans and prices, tax rates, coupons, mail settings and webhook endpoints. Never customers, usage, invoices or payments. It only adds: anything that already exists in live and differs is left alone.
promote.adminOnly: Only owners and administrators can do this.
promote.nothing: Nothing to copy: live already has everything the sandbox has.
promote.conflictNote: A conflict is an object that exists in live with different settings. It is left as it is; change it in live by hand if you want them to match.
promote.applyNote: Applies exactly the changes shown. If the configuration changed meanwhile, you are asked to preview again.
promote.secretOnce: A new signing secret was made for each webhook endpoint below. It is shown only now; the sandbox's secret was not copied.

sandbox.intro: Tools for the test environment: start again from a clean slate, and see how each kind of payment behaves.
sandbox.resetBody: Deletes the sandbox's customers, subscriptions, usage, invoices and payments. Plans, prices, meters, tax rates, coupons, webhook endpoints, mail settings and API keys stay. Live is never touched.
sandbox.byRetention: Started automatically after a long time without use.
sandbox.skipped: Skipped: not part of this deployment
sandbox.failedNote: Nothing is lost by trying again: every step can be repeated.
sandbox.neverReset: This sandbox has not been reset yet.
sandbox.confirmBody: All test customers, subscriptions, invoices and payments are deleted. This cannot be undone. Your configuration stays.
sandbox.scenariosBody: Give a sandbox customer one of these payment methods and their invoices behave as described. No real provider is ever called.

scenario.success: The charge succeeds and the invoice is paid.
scenario.declined: Every attempt is declined. After the retries the invoice becomes uncollectible.
scenario.insufficient_funds_once: The first attempt is declined, the retry succeeds.
scenario.error_then_success: The provider fails twice with a server error, then succeeds.
scenario.timeout_committed: The provider takes the payment but does not answer in time. A status check finds it.
scenario.timeout_not_committed: The provider does not answer and has not taken the payment. The charge is made again.

sandbox.simulateNote: To try one, open a sandbox invoice and use Simulate payment.
sandbox.simulateBody: Run this invoice's payment again as one of the scenarios. The customer keeps the scenario as their payment method.
sandbox.simulateNotRetried: The scenario is set, but the payment could not run again now ({why}).

privacy.banner: Privacy mode is on: amounts are hidden.

dash.stale: The numbers could not be refreshed; what you see is from the last time they could.
dash.degraded: {sections} did not answer. The rest of the page is up to date.

period.label: Period
period.badRange: The first day is after the last.

delta.srUp: Up {percent} compared with the previous period
delta.srDown: Down {percent} compared with the previous period
delta.srFlat: Unchanged compared with the previous period
delta.srNew: New compared with the previous period

chart.title: Net revenue
chart.note: After refunds and tax: the figure of the accounting page

payments.title: Payments
payments.label: {n} payment attempts
payments.note: Counted per attempt: a declined card that is retried counts each time, and refunds are counted apart.
payments.truncated: Only the newest 1000 payments are read; older ones in this period are not counted.

top.customersEmpty: Nobody has paid in this period.

usage.title: Usage against limits
usage.empty: None of the customers looked at has a limit.

renewals.title: Upcoming charges
renewals.empty: No charges in {currency} in the next 30 days.
renewals.truncated: Only the newest 200 subscriptions are looked at.
renewals.note: The date is when the fee or the month's invoice comes due.

empty.title: Nothing to show yet
empty.body: When your first customer is added and pays, revenue, subscriptions and payments appear here, one block per currency.

org.title: All apps
org.intro: Every app of the organisation over the same period. Money of different currencies is never added up.
org.none: No app has revenue in this period.
